name: Khalifa University
officialName: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
summary: Khalifa University traces back to KUSTAR, established by presidential decree in 2007; in 2017 KUSTAR, the Petroleum Institute and Masdar Institute merged into one university. It is a not-for-profit public institution whose core budget comes from the Government of Abu Dhabi. International applicants are automatically reviewed for merit scholarships.

internationalTuition.notes: AED 2,500 per credit hour; KU's estimated cost per year. Year of the schedule not stated.

scholarships.name: President's Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Reviewed automatically with the admission application; recipients must keep a cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher.
scholarships.coverage: Full; benefits may include tuition, textbooks and accommodation

scholarships.name: Partial scholarships for international students
scholarships.eligibility: International students in College of Science programmes; recipients must keep a 3.0 GPA.

admissionProcess.detail: International applicants (from schools outside the UAE) submit English test scores (IELTS or TOEFL) and any advanced-standing credits (A level, IB, AP).
No separate scholarship application: scholarships are reviewed automatically with the admission application.
